source.check: National result compared: Yes 520,898, No 1,412,602 (26.94% / 73.06%) against our outcome, yes %, no %. Agrees. Our file holds no vote counts (Yes and No are 0), so only the outcome and the percentages could be checked; the source counts could fill them. The data.gov.ie CSV still has the uncorrected Yes total of 521,798. The certified figure is 520,898 (corrected by the Department in 2016), which ours matches.
